title: Steps for Card-on-File for viewing Subscriptions

steps.text: Log in to the mobile application and land on the cards dashboard page.
Scroll between card using left and right arrows to choose card & Click on "My Subscriptions"

View a list of the selected credit card's subscriptions per 
card 
For each subscription, the app shows the following details: 
• Merchant name 
• Transaction date/time 
• Last transaction amount 
• Last transaction currency 
• Merchant address 
• The general subscription logo"My Subscriptions"

If the customer wants to manage their subscriptions, a note 
is displayed, instructing them to visit the merchant's 
website for actions like card updates or removal."My Subscriptions"

The customer can then choose to proceed with managing 
their subscriptions externally on the merchant's website by 
following the provided instructions.
